case.component: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
case.narrative: Despite receiving the recent software update intended to fix ongoing issues with the backup camera, the center stack remains woefully inadequate, hardware-wise, to properly handle all of the vehicle data. Sometimes now, the reverse camera is fine until halfway during my backup procedure when I'm halfway out in traffic and it suddenly shuts off.  If anything the unpredictable nature of the failures makes this a worse problem than before. Before the software update I could at least sit in the car for a minute or two and then try backing up and it would work most of the time. Now, it works a good amount of the time but randomly fails.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
